reproduce.title: Verify NVIDIA filter behavior during Screen Ruler use
reproduce.version_requirement: Latest stable PowerToys and current NVIDIA overlay software; the duplicate report reproduced on PowerToys 0.82.1.
prerequisites: Use a test system with NVIDIA overlay/filter features available and enabled.
steps: Choose Horizontal, Vertical, or Horizontal Spacing measurement mode.
Try the Bounds option and observe whether the NVIDIA notification/filter clears or returns.
Observe whether the notification or filter appears within five seconds of the measurement-mode selection.
Hover over and then move away from the Screen Ruler overlay; note whether that changes the filter.
reproduce.expected_result: Screen Ruler should not trigger an unsolicited NVIDIA filter notification or alter the screen image. Record current PowerToys and NVIDIA app versions if it occurs.
